# Zoption

> Zoption is a privacy-conscious personal budget and expense tracker for reviewing transactions, budgets, and monthly cash flow in a private workspace.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://zoption.site/): Product overview, voice & receipt entry, statement imports, and account creation.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://zoption.site/pricing): Transparent Free Plan (₱0) and Pro Plan (₱149/mo, ₱1,299/yr) comparisons with zero bank credential sharing.
- [Changelog & Updates](https://zoption.site/changelog): Version release notes, new features, and product improvements.
- [FAQ](https://zoption.site/faq): Plain-language answers about tracking expenses, imports, budgets, AI assistant, privacy, and billing.
- [Download Android Beta APK](https://zoption.site/install): Official native Android Beta APK with on-device receipt scanning and offline support.
- [Terms of Service](https://zoption.site/terms-of-service): Terms governing the service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://zoption.site/privacy-policy): Account, financial-data, assistant, and provider processing practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://zoption.site/cookie-policy): Necessary browser storage and privacy-preserving, cookieless web analytics.

## Search and verification

- Google Preferred Source: Users can add Zoption as a preferred source in Google Search and AI experiences via https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=zoption.site

## Product facts

- Users can speak naturally to log expenses via voice entry (speech-to-transaction parsing).
- Users can snap receipt photos or screenshots to automatically draft expense line items.
- Users can manually record transactions or import PDF bank statements, CSV, XLS, and XLSX files.
- Users review imported rows and verify duplicate warnings before saving them.
- Calculations use exact integer centavo accuracy to avoid floating-point drift.
- Users can track recurring charges using a Visual Renewal Calendar Interface displaying upcoming billing cycles, payment schedules across dates, and cash-flow impact on an interactive month-by-month grid.
- Zoption does not connect directly to banks and never asks for banking credentials.
- Each workspace begins empty and contains only records the user chooses to add.
- The optional AI assistant uses a separate consent flow and is strictly read-only.

## Boundaries

- Zoption is not financial, investment, tax, or legal advice.
- Do not describe Zoption as bank-affiliated, bank-connected, or endorsed by financial institutions.
- Refer to the linked legal pages for current privacy, cookie, and service terms.
